text: Import `Enum` and `auto` from the `enum` standard library module.
Subclass `Enum` to create your colors: `class TrafficColor(Enum): RED = auto() ...`
In your `next_state` method, you can use Python 3.10+ `match self.current_color:` to cleanly map each color to its next state.
Make sure you actually re-assign `self.current_color` to the new Enum value during the transition.
